cases.title: Audio language from an unreviewed later package is borrowed by an uncovered package and makes it watchable
codeEvidence: backend/availability/services/reconciliation.py:205-255 - group key is (content_type, tmdb_id, season, episode, provider, country) with offer_type subgroup; source package and variant are not group keys
backend/availability/services/reconciliation.py:460-470 and 617-639 - _language_value picks language from any observation in the group
backend/tracker/services/availability_reads.py:131-166 - _tracker_offer copies group-level audio_languages onto the rendered row
backend/tracker/services/entitlement_reads.py:95-143 - entitlement lineage is package/variant-bound but the language shown is not
steps: Seed package A (allow-NL verified subscription, no audio, no subtitles, reviewed) and its base-plan allow rule.
Assert detail: title unknown; A row is_accessible=false; A has no EN audio.
Insert package B (unreviewed subscription, EN audio, observed 3 minutes after A) in the same provider/country/offer-type group.
Re-read detail and the filtered watchlist report.

observedBeforeRepair.detail: A row reports audio_languages=[EN], is_accessible=true, title available_here

expectedAfterRepair.detail: A row keeps its own empty language set and is_accessible=false; B cannot confer EN; title stays unknown
expectedAfterRepair.report: GET /api/watchlist/report/?watchable=1&audio_languages=EN does not return the title
invariants: Language used for accessibility is bound to the same package and rendition as the rights
Detail row, title verdict and filtered report agree
Reverse observation order gives the same result

regressionAssertions: assert detail.offers[*] where source_package_id=pkg-a has no EN in audio_languages
assert detail.watchability.verdict == 'unknown'
assert report rows for this title are empty under watchable=1&audio_languages=EN
assert no raw provenance_reference/source package secret in any payload
crossPrDependencies: Corrected #222 head (reconciliation.py, availability_reads.py, entitlement_reads.py) is required; #223 evaluator cases begin after reconciliation and cannot catch this
#224 offer rows consume the corrected fields; #225 integration replay fixture must be refreshed to include two packages
cases.reproductionCommand: ./scripts/test-backend-isolated.sh tracker.tests.test_issue103_api.OfferProjectionTests -v 2 (add the two-package probe case; disposable PostgreSQL, mocked transport)

cases.title: A denied later package hides an earlier covered package and downgrades the title
codeEvidence: backend/availability/services/reconciliation.py:205-255 - one group per provider/country/offer class collapses distinct packages
backend/tracker/services/availability_reads.py:176-216 - _offer_lineage selects one observation via group-level chosen price/URL
backend/tracker/services/entitlement_reads.py:95-143 - a single lineage/variant drives rule lookup, so an allow on A is lost when B's variant is selected
backend/tracker/views.py:2857-2916 and 2990-3040 - _build_prime_offers rows and _prime_detail_response title aggregate from the collapsed set

databaseSeed.note: Same provider, country and offer class; distinct provider-content IDs, source package IDs and variant IDs. A's observation and rule remain valid throughout.

steps: Seed covered A observed three minutes ago; assert detail returns A as INCLUDED / PLAN_COVERS_TITLE and title available_here.
Add current package B of the same provider/country/offer class with a deny rule for B's exact variant.
Re-read detail.
Repeat with the observation order reversed.

observedBeforeRepair.detail: Only B remains, as BLOCKED; title available_elsewhere; A's valid positive is dropped

expectedAfterRepair.detail: Both eligible packages are evaluated before display row selection and title aggregation; A stays INCLUDED and the title stays available_here even though B is BLOCKED
invariants: Preserve both alternatives; never let a denied package suppress a positive from another package
Reversed observation order yields the same rows and title
Per-package deny applies only to its own variant

regressionAssertions: assert detail.offers contains a row with source_package_id=pkg-a and entitlement.verdict=INCLUDED
assert any BLOCKED row for pkg-b does not change watchability.verdict
assert detail.watchability.verdict == 'available_here'
assert repeated run with reversed insertion order produces equal keyed verdicts
crossPrDependencies: Corrected #222 head (reconciliation grouping, availability_reads lineage, entitlement_reads, views) is required
#223 cases E33-E35 cover same-scope allow/deny conflict within one offer, not two packages in one group
#225 integration replay must preserve both alternatives
cases.reproductionCommand: ./scripts/test-backend-isolated.sh tracker.tests.test_issue103_api.OfferProjectionTests -v 2 (add the two-package deny probe; disposable PostgreSQL, mocked transport)

cases.title: Contradictory country parameters make a row local while the title verdict uses a different country
codeEvidence: backend/tracker/views.py:2780-2804 - _current_country reads current_country only; _active_country reads current_country or legacy country
backend/tracker/views.py:2919-2934 - _prime_detail_response computes country via _active_country
backend/tracker/views.py:2882-2886 - _build_prime_offers recomputes current_country from query param country first
backend/tracker/views.py:2995-3025 - rows and title/availability are assembled from the two different countries
steps: With one covered NL offer, DE viewing location and VPN disabled, request ?current_country=DE.
Assert title available_elsewhere and an inaccessible row.
Append &country=NL and re-read.

observedBeforeRepair.detail: With both parameters, title stays available_elsewhere but the same row becomes local/accessible and qualifies for Best Match

expectedAfterRepair.detail: One effective viewing country is passed from _prime_detail_response into _build_prime_offers and used for every row and the title; contradictory parameters either both resolve to the same country or are rejected consistently
invariants: Row locality, accessibility and title verdict never disagree
Legacy country and current_country handling match the list surfaces (movie 615457 guard)

regressionAssertions: assert detail.offers[*].country locality matches the title verdict's effective country
assert no row is simultaneously local=true and outside the effective viewing country
assert existing backend/tracker/tests/test_surface_country_agreement.py still passes
crossPrDependencies: Corrected #222 head (views.py) is required
#224 UI displays the row locality badge and Best Match; #225 integration must replay the contradictory-parameter response consistently

steps: Save base at revision 1, then premium at revision 2.
Let base expire (outside active window).
Submit the old but structurally valid base draft at revision 1.

cases.title: Invalid-only language filter is treated as an absent filter and returns every row
codeEvidence: backend/tracker/services/filtering.py:319-323 - languages() returns an empty set for invalid-only input
backend/tracker/services/filtering.py:342-343 - 'not audio_filter' treats empty set as no predicate
steps: Seed one synthetic official result.
Request an invalid-only audio language code and compare with a matching EN filter.

observedBeforeRepair.detail: Both requests return the row; invalid-only input disables the predicate

expectedAfterRepair.detail: Distinguish absent filter from an active filter with zero recognized codes: return a validation error or zero matches consistently for official and unofficial rows
invariants: Absent param keeps current behavior
Invalid-only param never widens results

regressionAssertions: assert invalid-only response is either 400 or a result set with zero matches
assert matching EN response still returns the synthetic row
assert unofficial rows follow the same rule as official rows
crossPrDependencies: Corrected #222 head (filtering.py) is required
#224 filter/count UI must not double-count when the corrected predicate returns zero

databaseSeed.uiAction: change only a channel holding, then save
databaseSeed.note: Mocked UI + real API replay on disposable PostgreSQL.

steps: Load a retired selected plan with saved plan_id=base and display name 'base'.
Change only a channel and save.
Capture the PUT payload, then replay it through the real API and re-read the catalogue.

observedBeforeRepair.persisted: Saved plan ID and display name change from base to null

expectedAfterRepair.request: Either retain the exact existing retired plan_id (narrow backend exception for this profile) or require an explicit replacement before saving; newly submitted arbitrary IDs must still be rejected
expectedAfterRepair.persisted: plan_id=base and display name 'base' survive an unrelated channel edit; plan_state stays unsupported
invariants: Unsupported plan remains distinct from unspecified plan after catalogue retirement
No arbitrary new ID is accepted by the write API
The repaired UI payload replays through the real API without changing the retired selection

regressionAssertions: assert PUT payload does not send plan_id=null for an unchanged retired selection
assert re-read selection.plan_id == 'base' and plan_display_name == 'base'
assert PUT with a new arbitrary retired ID returns 400
assert #223 E18/E23/E24 (unsupported/expired plan) still pass
crossPrDependencies: Requires BOTH corrected #224 (frontend) and a narrow corrected #222 backend exception; this is the only case with a deliberate two-PR contract change
#220 contract section 'Unsupported plan means a declared plan has no supported mapping ... keep these reasons distinct, including after a formerly supported product retires'
#225 integration fixture must carry the retired display name across a save
